instructions.cross_packet_rule: Use cross_packet_terms for likely synonyms, owners, consumers, and seams outside this packet.
instructions.family_key_rule: Every assigned raw family key must have exactly one family_key_assignments row and at least one mapped feature.
instructions.objective: Normalize every assigned validated audit atom into an exhaustive local inventory of distinct Puppet Master features, systems, tools, workflows, GUI surfaces, integrations, data models, governance controls, or cross-cutting concerns. Preserve under-specification, contradictions, unknowns, and explicit non-gaps.
instructions.output_rule: Write exactly one strict-schema JSON payload in the assigned output directory and then return PMR1.
instructions.partition_rule: Every atom_id must appear in exactly one feature.atom_ids array; no omission or duplication.
instructions.research_rule: Do not browse in this phase. Give every normalized feature at least one concrete external-research question for the mandatory next phase; do not treat absence of seed queries as permission to omit research.
instructions.scenario_rule: Give every feature at least one falsifiable scenario requirement for later certification.
instructions.split_merge_rule: Split concepts with distinct lifecycle, authority, consumers, or failure semantics. Merge only true synonyms describing the same product concept; record aliases and relationships instead of collapsing uncertainty.

atoms.statement: The terminology, help, notification, badge, routing, and attention-projection units do not specify keyboard or screen-reader semantics, non-color status cues, focus/help behavior, pluralization, text expansion, truncation, or localized route-label acceptance.

atoms.statement: Concrete account, operational identity, switch-history, project, trust, and SSH-related GUI scope is declared without field-level redaction, role-based visibility, retention, screenshot/export handling, or purge requirements.
atoms.title: Concrete identity surfaces lack privacy and retention rules

atoms.statement: The stack and shell units lock technologies, renderer fallbacks, and fixed panel dimensions but do not define responsive breakpoints, minimum viable viewport, zoom/text-scale behavior, overflow priority, or renderer performance and recovery budgets.
atoms.title: Fixed shell geometry lacks cross-target adaptation limits

atoms.statement: System-tray Pause/Resume and Quit behavior is defined alongside multi-project workspace tabs, but command target scope, authority, confirmation, in-flight transitions, projection freshness, and project-switch races are unspecified.
atoms.title: Tray controls have no multi-project authority or race contract

atoms.statement: Spacing and space accounting name only 1920x1080 and 1280x720 reference layouts and do not establish interpolation, reflow, minimum-size, DPI, zoom, text expansion, focus-order, or accessible-label oracles for the canonical side-panel shell.
atoms.title: Reference layouts do not bound responsive and accessible behavior

atoms.statement: Search includes replace-in-files and follow-symlinks controls without defining preview and confirmation, path trust boundaries, stale-match revalidation, atomicity, concurrent-edit handling, partial-failure reporting, backup, undo, or rollback.
atoms.title: Replace-in-files has no destructive-action recovery contract

atoms.statement: The GitHub Actions, Run & Debug, object-record search, search taxonomy, and alias-reconciliation units name external owners and consumers yet retain empty dependency and unblocks lists plus generic migration acceptance criteria.
atoms.title: Shell owner boundaries are not represented as PlanUnit dependencies

cross_document_questions: Which owner contract defines authenticated and bounded postMessage validation for sandboxed visual modules?
Which runtime contract owns atomic replace-in-files, stale-match revalidation, backup, undo, and partial-failure recovery?
Where are tray Pause/Resume and Quit scoped when multiple project workspace tabs and runs are active?
Which owner defines redaction, role visibility, retention, and purge for concrete-account and operational-identity GUI data?
How are the named external owner and consumer dependencies represented before these PlanUnits are treated as node-ready?
